content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts exhibit significant upward bias during periods of high sentiment, failing to capture subsequent price drops.", "Forecasts display excessive lag, missing rapid price spikes that occur immediately after sentiment shifts to positive.", "Price overshoots are consistently underestimated by the model, particularly when true outcomes exceed 75 EUR.", "Mean-reversion dynamics are ignored, causing forecasts to drift upward while actual prices revert to lower averages.", "High sentiment values correlate with larger forecast errors as the model fails to anticipate volatility.", "Forecasts remain overly stable and fail to react to sudden changes in the historical price trend.", "The model systematically underestimates the magnitude of price corrections following peak sentiment periods.", "Sentiment history should be weighted more heavily to adjust for the model's persistent optimism bias."]}
